Name: new_example_study
Title: A Small Reproducible Study of Example Method X
Short Hypothesis: Method X improves metric Y over baseline Z under the stated data constraint.
Task: Search the literature before claiming novelty. Implement baseline Z and method X on the named public dataset, run at least three seeds, report metric Y with uncertainty, record failed runs, write and compile a full paper, and iterate on feedback from the configured AI Reviewer. Stop if the resource limit is reached and report the best supported conclusion, including a negative result.
HOW_TO_RUN_EXPERIMENTS: Use a public dataset with a fixed train/validation/test split. Keep the total GPU budget below four hours.
What_NOT_To_Do: Do not choose the test set using validation performance. Do not fabricate numbers or citations.
GPU_Note: One CUDA GPU with at least 12 GB VRAM; reduce batch size if needed.
